# Pinned Indra source

This directory contains the upstream Python package and license recovered from the OCR training workspace.

- Repository: https://github.com/datalab-to/indra
- Commit: `e20355319b5aa5705a876a8d2b40aca606d7df5f`
- Package version: `1.1.2`

The fine-tuning entry point is in the parent repository's `src/indra_training/`. Model weights are downloaded separately. This short packaging README was added during repository recovery; original source file hashes are recorded in `docs/source-manifest.json` at the repository root.
